prompt: Derived asset, not generated. Origin: public/images/6 layers textile.png (the client's pre-existing render, unchanged). Process: each of the render's six sheets was cut out along its visible outline. Front edges were traced from three corners read off the image and snapped to the strongest nearby image edge with a dynamic-programming path; each sheet's region is the area between the front edge of the sheet above and its own front edge. Small stray pieces were reassigned to the neighbouring sheet that shares the longest border, and isolated background specks (alpha below 8) were dropped. Each cut-out keeps the render's own pixels and sits unchanged in its own 1024x512 slot of a transparent 2048x2048 atlas, 16 px from the slot's corner, encoded as lossy WebP (quality 90, lossless alpha). Nothing hidden behind a sheet was reconstructed or generated. Used as the WebGL texture for the cinematic stage's scene B.
